term: groundwater storage change by the water-table fluctuation method: specific yield times the mean change in water level over the well set, over the basin area
route: USGS Water Data API daily collection through core's obs_capture.py (the discharge term's tool); the site file from the monitoring-locations collection; the candidate set from the time-series-metadata collection. A continuously recorded well is a daily series through usgs_daily rather than a field-measurements series, as the groundwater connector concept says

criteria: a daily mean series of parameter 72019 whose record begins on or before the window's start and ends on or after its end
the well inside the basin polygon
aquifer type code U (unconfined) in the site file, because a confined well's head change is not a storage change at specific yield
a constructed depth stated in the site file

specific_yield.source: Gehman and others 2009, Water Resources Research 45(4), DOI 10.1029/2007WR006096: specific yield 0.21 plus or minus 0.03 for an unconfined alluvial aquifer in northeastern Colorado from temporal gravity surveys against measured water-level change, within the range of the site's aquifer tests (the Crossref record and abstract, read 2026-09-15); Pool and Eychaner 1995, Groundwater 33(3) 425-432, DOI 10.1111/j.1745-6584.1995.tb00299.x, measured 0.16 to 0.21 at alluvial wells by the same method (abstract read 2026-09-15). A single value for a well set spanning glacial, alluvial and bedrock aquifers is a stated assumption, not a basin property; the compilation of record, Johnson 1967, USGS Water-Supply Paper 1662-D, DOI 10.3133/wsp1662D, is cited on its registry record because its landing page was not reachable from the drafting session
specific_yield.applies_to: unconfined wells only; the term is linear in this value and the receipt reports it at the value and at one sigma either side

parameters.sign: depth to water decreasing is the water level rising: the level change is the first-window mean depth minus the last-window mean depth, positive when storage rose

screened_interval_note: the Water Data API serves the constructed depth and the hole depth of a well and not its screened interval; the depth stated for every well here is the constructed depth from the site file
